newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil '96 social security deficit 1.2 bln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil '96 social security deficit 1.2 bln reais.

text.p: Brazil's social security system closed 1996 1.2 billion reais in the red, Social Security Minister Reinhold Stephanes said Friday.
The deficit in the public pension and national insurance results was less than the 3.0 billion reais shortfall government officials had been predicting earlier in the year.
Stephanes said a blitz on social security evaders at the end of last year would continue into 1997 in order to boost revenue.
In 1996, total social security reveune was 40.6 billion reais while payouts totalled 41.8 billion reais.
